verdict.reason: Each of the 16 modern capabilities has at least one finite P0 semantic closure defect. This is not a request for customer production data or G6 activation.

method: Read all 199 operation rows, 115 table specifications, 155 event schemas and 25 handler rows from the exact source snapshot.
Compared the candidate against the 16-capability minimum redesign matrix in the 2026-09-14 global product semantic audit.
Separated envelope/type existence from reproducible business meaning, subject authority, effective-time, privacy, decision and immutable result provenance.
Did not modify the canonical five, physical successor or gate state.

findings.title: 60 of 66 query entity schemas expose only a five-field envelope
findings.whyBlocking: additionalProperties=false prevents implementation from returning any actual HR business field; field-policy prose cannot enlarge a closed schema.
findings.falsePositiveAnalysis: The five envelope fields are valid common metadata; the defect is their use as the complete entity contract.

minimumCanonicalContract.request: retain filters and exact subject/as-of inputs
minimumCanonicalContract.response: define typed business record per aggregate; use minimumBusinessProjectionByCapability and field-policy masks
minimumCanonicalContract.dml: read named physical columns/immutable artifacts only
minimumCanonicalContract.event: events not required for pure query
minimumCanonicalContract.handler: no query handler
minimumCanonicalContract.schema: closed additionalProperties=false entity schemas with exact field lineage

findings.title: 16 async handlers use generic lifecycle states incompatible with their aggregate enums
findings.whyBlocking: several handlers cannot select a pre-state or persist a post-state accepted by DDL; even schema-compatible rows such as expire use the wrong business outcome.
findings.falsePositiveAnalysis: REQUESTED/RUNNING->COMPLETED/FAILED is legitimate only for true async request aggregates, not for candidate, engagement, enrollment, case, offer, schedule or expiry semantics.

minimumCanonicalContract.request: signed owner result includes exact request/aggregate id, expected revision, outcome and payload digest
minimumCanonicalContract.response: return/refetch typed domain outcome and immutable proof
minimumCanonicalContract.dml: claim inbox; lock actual request/root; append typed result proof; update exact domain state; close inbox; append outbox
minimumCanonicalContract.event: condition on actual domain outcome, not event name
minimumCanonicalContract.handler: per-handler pre/post map and compensation/retry behavior
minimumCanonicalContract.schema: DDL checks exactly contain every handler state; separate async request state from business aggregate state

findings.title: 10 command events and 17 handler events compare to event names rather than reachable states
findings.whyBlocking: the outbox condition is never true, so declared public facts have no producer even when state mutation commits.
findings.falsePositiveAnalysis: An event type may resemble a transition name, but the contract explicitly evaluates `toState`; no alias registry maps these event-name literals.

minimumCanonicalContract.request: decision inputs resolve to exact post-state
minimumCanonicalContract.response: receipt returns committed state/event facts
minimumCanonicalContract.dml: outbox after closed receipt only
minimumCanonicalContract.event: use `toState=CONFIRMED`, `toState=ACCEPTED`, etc., or ALWAYS for a single committed fact
minimumCanonicalContract.handler: handler event condition uses actual ownerResult/domain state
minimumCanonicalContract.schema: state enum and event condition validator must prove reachability

findings.title: 18 self-service mutations lack an exact caller-to-subject/ownership predicate
findings.whyBlocking: tenant membership and a self capability do not prove that a caller-supplied worker UUID or selected aggregate belongs to the caller.
findings.falsePositiveAnalysis: A validated HRM.Worker owner ref proves existence and tenant, not self identity. A manager/operations proxy remains valid only through a distinct duty and recorded delegation.

minimumCanonicalContract.request: self routes derive worker from authenticated principal or require equality; proxy routes use distinct capability plus delegation reason
minimumCanonicalContract.response: self query/mutation never reveals another subject; proxy response records acting-on-behalf-of
minimumCanonicalContract.dml: persist derived subject and delegation receipt, never arbitrary self-route worker input
minimumCanonicalContract.event: include actor/subject/delegation revision where consumers need the decision
minimumCanonicalContract.handler: PEP asserts tenant+purpose+population+subject before DML
minimumCanonicalContract.schema: unique/index/RLS predicates support worker ownership and delegated scopes

findings.title: Candidate intake and hire handoff do not create reproducible candidate/hire facts
findings.whyBlocking: candidate.admit has no candidate/source/consent input and does not populate requisition_id; the hire handler updates candidate stage with generic states and never appends the declared handoff receipt; offer response has no candidate/proxy decision provenance.
findings.falsePositiveAnalysis: Offer amount/currency and compensation-policy version are a real improvement and are not reported as missing; a full vendor ATS or resume blob is not required.

minimumCanonicalContract.request: candidate person token, source system/key, consent receipt+expiry, requisition selector; offer response actor/proxy receipt
minimumCanonicalContract.response: candidate detail returns stage history, offers and hire handoff; redact candidate identity by field policy
minimumCanonicalContract.dml: insert candidate and initial history atomically; append immutable hire handoff receipt before HIRED
minimumCanonicalContract.event: emit APPLIED and exact ACCEPTED/DECLINED/HIRED or handoff-failed facts from real states
minimumCanonicalContract.handler: handoff handler locks hire request+candidate HIRE_PENDING, verifies owner ack, writes worker/employment/assignment refs
minimumCanonicalContract.schema: typed consent/source columns and immutable offer terms artifact or closed minimum terms schema

findings.title: Template tasks cannot express actor, due anchor, condition or evidence policy; waiver is empty
findings.whyBlocking: a task title/type plus dueOffset cannot determine who acts, what starts the offset, whether the task applies, or what evidence completes/waives it; assignment DML also omits instance due_at.
findings.falsePositiveAnalysis: The existing typed task array is useful and need not become one table per vendor screen; it is simply not a closed executable task graph yet.

minimumCanonicalContract.request: task actorRule, dueAnchor+offset, applicability condition version, completion/evidence schema ref; waiver reason+human authorization receipt
minimumCanonicalContract.response: template and journey queries return typed definitions/instances/evidence
minimumCanonicalContract.dml: append immutable template version; materialize N tasks with actor/due/condition snapshot; append complete/waive revision and evidence
minimumCanonicalContract.event: task completed/waived and journey completed only when required task predicate holds
minimumCanonicalContract.handler: optional owner-port checks for documents/workflow plus exact actor PEP
minimumCanonicalContract.schema: versioned task definition children or immutable typed artifact with exact refetch; producer for assignment/task revision tables

findings.title: Scenario revisions persist digests but no typed assumptions or results
findings.whyBlocking: organization/config/snapshot IDs and result digests cannot reconstruct headcount, skills, cost, currency, time horizon or scenario deltas; revise is bodyless.
findings.falsePositiveAnalysis: Pinned population/organization snapshots and deterministic seed are valid inputs. The defect is absence of the typed assumption/result artifact behind those pins.

minimumCanonicalContract.request: as-of population snapshot plus typed assumption artifact/version, unit/currency and horizon; revise supplies a replacement revision
minimumCanonicalContract.response: scenario query returns immutable assumptions and result lines/refetch handle
minimumCanonicalContract.dml: append scenario revision with exact artifact IDs/revisions and simulation result receipt; never overwrite prior revision
minimumCanonicalContract.event: emit revised/simulated/approved/published with revision/result refs
minimumCanonicalContract.handler: simulation result handler verifies request digest and appends immutable typed result
minimumCanonicalContract.schema: typed assumption/result line children or content artifact with schema version, digest, owner and exact historical refetch

findings.title: Enrollment eligibility/dependent snapshot and provider request lifecycle are not reproducible
findings.whyBlocking: the election stores caller-supplied dependent tokens without an eligibility/relationship snapshot or eligibility decision receipt; no producer creates provider_requests, while its handler requires one; life-event expiry targets enrollment with impossible states.
findings.falsePositiveAnalysis: Coverage options already carry contribution money/currency/component and eligibility/window config refs; generic benefits is not excluded BENSK/ADDSK.

minimumCanonicalContract.request: self-derived worker, exact plan version, selected option, dependent relationship tokens, eligibility snapshot+decision receipt, life-event link
minimumCanonicalContract.response: eligible plan/election query returns effective option price/frequency, coverage and provider status without exposing dependent identity
minimumCanonicalContract.dml: insert election+eligibility proof; on approval append provider request; handler appends result receipt and maps provider outcome to enrollment domain state
minimumCanonicalContract.event: submitted/decided/provider-result/cancelled events reference exact plan/election revision
minimumCanonicalContract.handler: provider handler locks provider request and enrollment; life-event expiry locks life event, not an unrelated generic state
minimumCanonicalContract.schema: versioned option/dependent-election children or immutable typed election artifact; provider request/result producer and refetch

findings.title: Case request/response content has only a digest and SLA handler corrupts case lifecycle
findings.whyBlocking: case create contains no request content/artifact; responses persist only a digest with no immutable object reference; assignment has no assignee/queue decision; the SLA handler uses REQUESTED/RUNNING and COMPLETED/FAILED against OPEN/TRIAGED/IN_PROGRESS/WAITING/RESOLVED/CANCELLED.
findings.falsePositiveAnalysis: Sensitive case text need not be stored in the case table; an encrypted immutable content owner is preferred. Digest-only is insufficient without exact owner/refetch.

minimumCanonicalContract.request: encrypted request/response artifact id+revision, attachments refs, visibility, requester derived from self or proxy, assignee/queue decision
minimumCanonicalContract.response: case query returns permitted content refs, action history and SLA clock
minimumCanonicalContract.dml: append action with artifact refs; update case state separately; append SLA milestone without replacing case status
minimumCanonicalContract.event: case action/SLA events expose no raw content and use exact case revision
minimumCanonicalContract.handler: SLA handler appends measurement and optionally raises breach action; it never maps milestone outcome to generic case state
minimumCanonicalContract.schema: action artifact/ref columns, SLA pause/resume intervals and tenant-configured case/queue/policy versions

findings.title: Classification and access control are declared but have no producer or independent state
findings.whyBlocking: create does not accept/persist classification despite a non-null column; activate creates no access request; three access handlers write only generic engagement status and no access/classification/expiry proof; sponsor reassignment has no new sponsor input.
findings.falsePositiveAnalysis: Vendor, worker, sponsor and effective interval refs are useful. This does not require a shared vendor database—typed owner ports are sufficient.

minimumCanonicalContract.request: classification intent+policy/decision receipt, access package/scope/expiry, sponsor replacement+effective interval
minimumCanonicalContract.response: engagement query returns classification and access grant/revoke/expiry receipts under restricted policy
minimumCanonicalContract.dml: append classification receipt; append access request; handle grant/revoke in separate access state; close sponsor interval then append new assignment
minimumCanonicalContract.event: engagement activated only after approved classification and access grant; access events do not masquerade as engagement states
minimumCanonicalContract.handler: handlers lock access request and append immutable result/expiry receipts; engagement becomes ACTIVE/ENDED only under explicit transition
minimumCanonicalContract.schema: closed classification vocabulary/version, access request/result schema, non-overlapping sponsor intervals

findings.title: Taxonomy node/edge/band tables contain only generic fact-envelope fields and evidence admission is empty
findings.whyBlocking: there is nowhere to store a skill code/label, edge endpoints/relation, proficiency code/order or taxonomy version linkage; evidence.record has no worker/skill/proficiency/provenance/consent input.
findings.falsePositiveAnalysis: Content digests are valid integrity checks after typed graph materialization; they are not the graph.

minimumCanonicalContract.request: taxonomy revision carries nodes(code,label,locale), edges(source,target,type), ordered proficiency bands; evidence carries worker, skill+taxonomy version, band, source, observedAt, consent/provenance
minimumCanonicalContract.response: taxonomy/evidence queries return exact versioned graph and verified evidence
minimumCanonicalContract.dml: append a new immutable taxonomy version and children; append evidence PENDING; verification only matches exact source receipt
minimumCanonicalContract.event: published taxonomy and evidence recorded/verified/revoked events carry exact revision refs
minimumCanonicalContract.handler: optional external evidence verifier returns signed receipt; no automated proficiency decision without configured rule/human boundary
minimumCanonicalContract.schema: typed node/edge/band columns/FKs/uniques; evidence consent receipt and taxonomy-version FK

findings.title: Immutable content references and evidence consent are persisted without validating exact owner revisions
findings.whyBlocking: profilePatch/coaching contain artifact IDs/revisions and coach principal but selectors do not refetch either artifact or principal; evidence.link derives a consent revision that is absent from the request and has no consent receipt; self ownership is not enforced.
findings.falsePositiveAnalysis: External immutable encrypted artifacts are an acceptable alternative to storing confidential text locally, and the new typed evidence-ref child tables are useful.

minimumCanonicalContract.request: artifact id+revision+schema/digest, evidence refs with consent receipt/version/expiry; coach is caller or exact delegated principal
minimumCanonicalContract.response: profile query returns exact historical artifact/evidence/coaching refs by permitted visibility
minimumCanonicalContract.dml: owner-refetch every artifact/principal/evidence revision before append; persist consent receipt not an invented revision
minimumCanonicalContract.event: revision/coaching/evidence-linked events use immutable revision refs and no confidential text
minimumCanonicalContract.handler: content/evidence owner port denies stale, cross-tenant, withdrawn-consent and unauthorized visibility
minimumCanonicalContract.schema: artifact schema/version/digest columns or typed owner-proof receipt; consent expiry/revocation linkage

findings.title: Offerings have no executable content/capacity/skill version and administrative assignment creation is empty
findings.whyBlocking: offering stores provider and digest but no content artifact/version, capacity, eligibility or skills; assignment.create has no worker/offering/due/source input, so mandatory learning cannot be assigned.
findings.falsePositiveAnalysis: Self enrollment already carries offering, worker, effective date and consent revision; completion verification has a meaningful evidence owner-refetch path.

minimumCanonicalContract.request: offering content artifact+revision, delivery/session/capacity/eligibility/skill mappings; assignment worker/offering exact revision/due/assignment source; self worker derived
minimumCanonicalContract.response: catalog returns usable offering facts; assignment returns due/progress/completion evidence
minimumCanonicalContract.dml: append offering version and mappings; reserve capacity/waitlist atomically; create assignment with exact source policy
minimumCanonicalContract.event: offering/assignment/enrollment/completion events distinguish self vs required assignment
minimumCanonicalContract.handler: provider/completion owner receipts verify content/completion; capacity retry is idempotent
minimumCanonicalContract.schema: versioned offering child/artifact schema, capacity ledger, skill taxonomy version refs, assignment source and consent receipt

findings.title: Opportunity criteria/capacity and explanation provenance are absent
findings.whyBlocking: an opportunity has only name/org/dates; no type, capacity, eligibility, skill criteria or assignment terms. Application statement and explanation are digests without immutable artifact/refetch; shortlist receives explanationId but does not persist it.
findings.falsePositiveAnalysis: Human decision and prohibited-attribute count concepts are present and should be retained; they do not prove the explanation or decision input.

minimumCanonicalContract.request: typed opportunity artifact+version/capacity/criteria; self-derived applicant and consent receipt; shortlist explanation artifact+policy/input revision; selection human receipt
minimumCanonicalContract.response: catalog/application query returns criteria, status, typed explanation factors and decision receipt subject to field policy
minimumCanonicalContract.dml: append immutable opportunity revision; append application; append explanation linked by ID; update only from exact human decision
minimumCanonicalContract.event: published/applied/shortlisted/selected/rejected events reference exact revisions, never ranking raw features
minimumCanonicalContract.handler: any model match is advisory through governed-AI owner and requires human selection; non-AI rule path remains available
minimumCanonicalContract.schema: opportunity version/criteria/skill mappings, statement artifact ref, explanation id/factors, decision receipt

findings.title: Restricted succession evidence and consent/audience versions are not anchored
findings.whyBlocking: plan stores an audience policy ID but not the exact revision supplied/selected; nomination stores a raw consent revision and evidence digest without consent/evidence refetch; readiness.record has no nomination/evidence input.
findings.falsePositiveAnalysis: Key-position and worker owner refs are valid. A plan does not need to expose succession data to employees merely because the worker exists.

minimumCanonicalContract.request: audience policy id+revision, key position, nomination worker, consent receipt+expiry, readiness vocabulary version, evidence id+revision/digest/review due
minimumCanonicalContract.response: query enforces restricted audience and returns nomination/readiness history only under exact policy revision
minimumCanonicalContract.dml: append nominations and readiness evidence linked to nomination; never overwrite evidence; publish pins audience approval
minimumCanonicalContract.event: nomination/readiness/approval/publish events carry no sensitive assessment, only exact restricted refs
minimumCanonicalContract.handler: evidence/consent/audience owner refetch fails closed and reauthorizes every call
minimumCanonicalContract.schema: audience revision column/check, readiness vocabulary/config version, consent receipt, typed evidence reference and expiry

findings.title: Proposal admission is empty and approved snapshot accepts untrusted replacement lines
findings.whyBlocking: proposal.upsert has no worker/component/money/effective input; cycle create omits required budget money; snapshot.publish lets the caller provide arbitrary lines and does not bind each line to approved proposal versions or budget balance.
findings.falsePositiveAnalysis: Money is correctly modeled as decimal string plus currency in budget/snapshot value objects; the defect is provenance, cross-currency policy and absent proposal creation.

minimumCanonicalContract.request: cycle budget Money and FX policy snapshot; proposal worker+assignment+component catalog revision+Money+effective date+reason; snapshot request only approved plan/revision
minimumCanonicalContract.response: queries expose budget balance, proposal version/history and immutable approved lines under compensation field policy
minimumCanonicalContract.dml: append budget ledger; insert/update proposal with CAS; approval freezes proposal IDs+versions; server derives snapshot lines from approved plan
minimumCanonicalContract.event: proposal/plan/snapshot events identify exact revision and money currency, never mutable request-only lines
minimumCanonicalContract.handler: optional approval handler validates decision receipt and budget; no automatic pay update—handoff to PAY owner is explicit
minimumCanonicalContract.schema: money checks, component catalog/country-pack version, FX snapshot where needed, proposal version history and snapshot FK to source proposal revisions

findings.title: Optimization result has no candidate/shift-line producer and hard-couples every run to AI fairness
findings.whyBlocking: schedule.optimize creates only an optimization request; result handler tries to UPDATE a schedule candidate that no operation creates and writes no candidate version/shift lines. A mandatory SYS.AIFairnessEvaluation also prevents a deterministic rule optimizer from being a generic core path.
findings.falsePositiveAnalysis: Forecast demand lines are now typed and schedule time-group refs are normalized; those improvements remain valid. Fairness constraints remain required, but AI-governance proof is conditional on algorithm mode.

minimumCanonicalContract.request: optimization mode discriminator; exact forecast/input/availability/rule snapshots; governed-AI proof only for AI mode
minimumCanonicalContract.response: candidate query returns candidate version and full typed shift/constraint/fairness/approval/publish facts
minimumCanonicalContract.dml: result handler locks optimization request, appends candidate+version+shift lines+time groups, closes request; validation appends receipts; publish calls TIM owner once
minimumCanonicalContract.event: generated/failed/validated/submitted/approved/rejected/published conditions use real states
minimumCanonicalContract.handler: optimizer result schema includes candidate digest, shifts, skills with taxonomy version/band, time zone/tzdb, coverage and proof; approval handler maps to APPROVED/REJECTED design state
minimumCanonicalContract.schema: candidate creator and immutable versions, typed skill refs, unique shift line keys, interval/time-zone checks and publish ledger

findings.title: Anonymous response path is linked to authenticated receipts and persists no answers
findings.whyBlocking: response.submit uses authenticatedPrincipal, a general command receipt and correlation ID, accepts no token or typed answers, lets the respondent choose eraseAfter, and does not bind admission_version; 15 listening support tables have no exact DML producer in the canonical five.
findings.falsePositiveAnalysis: The separate configuration/protected/insights/issuer static architecture is directionally correct and raw response events are absent as required; static owner names are not an exact transactional field contract.

minimumCanonicalContract.request: one-time anonymous participation envelope/token plus survey admission version and typed answer values; erase date server-derived from retention policy
minimumCanonicalContract.response: active survey returns question schema; cohort query returns threshold-safe bucket values/count policy and lineage only
minimumCanonicalContract.dml: token-scoped protected receipt claims first; atomically consume token, append response+answers, close anonymous receipt; erasure owner destroys content/key and retains non-linkable tombstone
minimumCanonicalContract.event: no raw response event or cross-stream correlation; only minimized cohort package/projection receipts
minimumCanonicalContract.handler: fully specify all eight listening owner handlers with input, writes, idempotency, ack and rollback; no authenticated principal on anonymous submit
minimumCanonicalContract.schema: versioned question/answer schemas, protected answer encryption, token consumption uniqueness, admission FK, cohort privacy budget and erasure tables

findings.title: Metric definition incorrectly accepts projection outputs while projection/export results are never stored
findings.whyBlocking: metric.create accepts cohortDefinitionId/anonymityThreshold/asOf/calculatedAt/subjectCount—projection inputs/outputs—but persists none and has no typed metric expression. projection.request has no as-of/cohort/population input and its result handler appends no projection row. Export result writes no object reference/digest/row count.
findings.falsePositiveAnalysis: The new typed child table for export projection IDs is correct. Digest-only lineage can remain as an integrity field after named sources/expressions and immutable projection values exist.

minimumCanonicalContract.request: metric definition: typed expression/aggregation/unit/dimensions/source contracts; projection request: exact metric version/as-of/cohort/population snapshot/purpose; export: exact projection revisions and bounded retention
minimumCanonicalContract.response: metric/projection/export query returns typed definition/value/lineage/object receipt under privacy policy
minimumCanonicalContract.dml: append metric version; create projection request; handler appends immutable projection values/lineage then closes request; export handler stores object ref/digest/count and expiry
minimumCanonicalContract.event: validated/published/projected/exported/expired events use actual state and privacy-safe refs
minimumCanonicalContract.handler: projection/export handlers verify signed owner result, purpose/population and threshold; expiry only sets EXPIRED and revokes object
minimumCanonicalContract.schema: metric-expression AST/schema, dimension/unit registry versions, typed projection values, export object reference and retention fence

findings.title: AI assistance/evaluation queries reuse a policy record and evaluation results have no receipt producer
findings.whyBlocking: all six AI query schemas expose the same policy proof fields. Evaluation queries omit outcome/suite/blocking failures/result digest; assistance queries omit instruction/source projection/result details; policy queries incorrectly source per-assistance disclosure evidence from a table outside their read plan. Evaluation handler never appends sys_hris_ai_evaluation_receipts, and assistance handler declares invalid COMPLETED.
findings.falsePositiveAnalysis: The central AI governance proof set, kill switch, monitoring expiry, `autonomous_employment_decision_allowed=false`, raw-prompt prohibition and human-confirmation concept are strong and should be preserved.

minimumCanonicalContract.request: assistance/evaluation/policy have distinct closed request schemas and exact subject ownership; review includes human actor/reason/decision receipt
minimumCanonicalContract.response: distinct entity records: policy proof; assistance instruction/source/result/human confirmation; evaluation suite/outcome/failures/result receipt
minimumCanonicalContract.dml: assistance result appends provenance and sets PRODUCED/FAILED; evaluation result appends evaluation receipt and sets COMPLETED/FAILED
minimumCanonicalContract.event: events use PRODUCED/FAILED/CONFIRMED/REJECTED etc. and immutable result receipt refs
minimumCanonicalContract.handler: central governance revalidated on every call; human confirmation cannot apply another user's assistance; evaluation handler writes signed immutable receipt
minimumCanonicalContract.schema: separate query schemas/lineage per aggregate; evaluation receipt producer; requester/subject ownership and exact historical result refetch

findings.title: Tenant/country configurable codes are stored without an exact vocabulary or country-pack version
findings.whyBlocking: not a universal G3 stop if exact config validation exists elsewhere, but the current exact contracts contain no vocabulary revision/refetch for these codes.
findings.falsePositiveAnalysis: The code strings need not be hardcoded enums or actual customer golden data at G3; they should be validated against versioned tenant config/country pack.

minimumCanonicalContract.request: code plus vocabulary/config version
minimumCanonicalContract.response: return code and resolved localized label/version
minimumCanonicalContract.dml: persist exact version with code
minimumCanonicalContract.event: event exposes code only when audience permits and pins version
minimumCanonicalContract.handler: SYS config owner validates active/effective version
minimumCanonicalContract.schema: composite code+version reference or immutable config receipt

findings.title: Money fields lack frequency/FX/basis boundaries needed for multinational use
findings.whyBlocking: decimal+currency is correct but cannot compare annual/monthly/per-pay-period amounts or balance cross-currency budgets without frequency/basis and an exact FX policy snapshot.
findings.falsePositiveAnalysis: No binary-float or integer-minor-unit defect was found; current DECIMAL(19,4) string wire values are acceptable.

minimumCanonicalContract.request: Money plus frequency/basis; FX snapshot only when currencies differ
minimumCanonicalContract.response: display original and reporting money without lossy conversion
minimumCanonicalContract.dml: persist original currency/value and pinned FX conversion proof
minimumCanonicalContract.event: events preserve original money and conversion revision
minimumCanonicalContract.handler: country pack owns tax/pay frequency; finance/FX owner supplies immutable rate snapshot
minimumCanonicalContract.schema: currency checks, scale, frequency code and optional FX receipt

findings.title: Several consequential decisions do not distinguish subject action from administrator proxy recording
findings.whyBlocking: actor provenance affects consent, appeal and audit. Current operations can change the state but do not say whether the affected person acted or an operator recorded an external decision.
findings.falsePositiveAnalysis: Not every cancellation requires common approval. A self action can use authenticated subject evidence; a proxy needs a distinct duty/reason/source receipt.

minimumCanonicalContract.request: actorMode SELF|AUTHORIZED_PROXY with exact subject/delegation/source receipt and reason when proxy
minimumCanonicalContract.response: return actor mode and audit-safe receipt ref
minimumCanonicalContract.dml: append immutable decision fact before state update
minimumCanonicalContract.event: event includes decision source class, not sensitive content
minimumCanonicalContract.handler: DWP PEP enforces distinct self/proxy duties
minimumCanonicalContract.schema: decision ledger fields for actor/source/delegation revision

findings.title: Revision operations do not define correction versus future-effective supersession semantics
findings.whyBlocking: the product needs audit-safe corrections and future changes without rewriting history; current revise commands are bodyless and state-only.
findings.falsePositiveAnalysis: Open-ended effective_to is explicitly modeled and is not itself a defect.

minimumCanonicalContract.request: revision mode CORRECTION|SUPERSEDE, effectiveFrom/To, changed fields/artifact and reason
minimumCanonicalContract.response: as-of query returns the exact revision and correction lineage
minimumCanonicalContract.dml: append new revision; correction never mutates published historical facts except controlled reversal/supersession
minimumCanonicalContract.event: event states revision mode/effective time and predecessor
minimumCanonicalContract.handler: no asynchronous handler required unless external owner proof is involved
minimumCanonicalContract.schema: non-overlap/exclusion constraints, predecessor revision and correction reason

distinct waiver duty plus delegated actor policy

falsePositives.reason: A digest is valid for integrity when paired with typed local rows or an immutable typed artifact/version and exact historical refetch. Forecast demand lines and growth artifact references illustrate the intended pattern.

Publish/start/cancel can be bodyless when locked state plus previously sealed approval/reason/effective-time facts fully determine the transition. Empty create/revise/evidence/reassign operations are the actual defect.

falsePositives.claim: Every UUID reference must become a local foreign key.
falsePositives.reason: Cross-boundary public UUIDs are correct when entity-typed, tenant/purpose/version validated by the owner and retained with exact refetch. Cross-service local IDs remain forbidden.

falsePositives.claim: Actual customer country-pack values and golden data are required before G3.
falsePositives.reason: G3 needs schemas, versioned configuration references, algorithms and synthetic fixtures. Actual legal/provider/customer activation remains G6.

falsePositives.claim: Generic benefits is excluded because BENSK/ADDSK are excluded.
falsePositives.reason: The optional generic benefits capability is a product-core design and does not reuse excluded company-specific BENSK/ADDSK behavior.
The central proof set, kill switch, monitoring and autonomous-decision=false controls are sound. The exact aggregate/query/result lifecycle must be repaired.

falsePositives.claim: The Listening static design already proves exact runtime behavior.
falsePositives.reason: It proves ownership direction and stream separation, but its handler rows carry domain table names rather than exact field-level DML, token/receipt schemas and atomic predicates.

falsePositives.claim: Field-policy prose can add omitted query fields at runtime.
falsePositives.reason: All affected Entity schemas set additionalProperties=false, so undeclared business fields would violate the response schema.

remediationOrder: Freeze this exact snapshot as failed evidence; do not mutate historical hashes.
Define capability-specific query records for all 66 queries and exact field lineage.
Replace generic handler lifecycle/event templates with object-specific request/result/proof machines.
Close the 16 capability-specific request/DML/schema/refetch gaps, preserving tenant-config/country-pack and DWP PEP boundaries.
Regenerate the canonical five and manifest from one source, then run an independent validator against the new hashes.
Only after author and independent zero-P0 results may physical successor generation and G3 gate transition resume.

validation.semantics: A PASS means the report exactly reproduces defects in the pinned failed candidate; it is not a G3 readiness PASS.
